one_line: Kushan emperor who standardized imperial gold coinage along the Indo-Roman trade routes and expanded power around Mathura.

appearance.age_look: mid-40s, tall and broad-shouldered, solid warrior’s build
appearance.face: broad oval face with strong jaw, high cheekbones, deep-set sharp eyes, straight nose and neatly trimmed moustache, medium wheat-brown Central Asian-Indian complexion, default expression calm and commanding with a slight stern focus
appearance.hair: thick black hair with slight wave, medium length tied into a compact topknot at the crown, sides combed back cleanly; encircled by a simple gold circlet-diadem with a small central boss and no tall spikes, worn firmly above the forehead
appearance.costume: era-accurate Kushan royal riding coat: a thigh-length, front-wrapped kaftan of heavy deep-red wool, edged with narrow gold braid and closed with a visible row of small round gold buttons from chest to hip, over a oatmeal-coloured long-sleeve tunic; a wide leather belt dyed dark brown sits at the natural waist with a ornate rectangular gold buckle bearing a simple stepped motif; straight dark-indigo trousers tucked into sturdy knee-high leather boots dyed warm brown, with slightly flared tops and stitched seams; over his shoulders a rich saffron-yellow woolen cloak drapes from the left side, pinned at the right shoulder with a round gold brooch; minimal jewellery: a pair of small gold hoop earrings and one plain gold armlet above the right elbow over the coat sleeve, no overloaded ornaments, all textiles solid-colour without fantasy patterns but with subtle woven texture
appearance.signature: a large Kushan gold coin held between thumb and forefinger of his right hand, clearly round and thick with a faintly indicated royal figure at a fire altar on one side, while at his left hip hangs a sheathed straight iron sword with a simple dark wood hilt and plain scabbard, secondary and quiet compared to the coin

ref_desc: Vima Kadphises is a mid-40s broad-shouldered emperor with wheat-brown skin, black topknot hair and gold circlet, wearing a deep-red Kushan kaftan, saffron cloak, indigo trousers and brown boots, holding a Kushan gold coin with a simple sword at his hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Vima Kadphises: a tall, broad-shouldered man in his mid-40s with a broad oval face, strong jaw, high cheekbones, deep-set sharp eyes, straight nose and a neatly trimmed moustache, medium wheat-brown complexion, and a calm commanding expression. His thick black hair is tied into a compact topknot at the crown with the sides combed back, encircled by a simple gold circlet-diadem with a small central boss. He wears a thigh-length, front-wrapped Kushan royal kaftan of deep-red wool, edged in narrow gold braid and closed with small round gold buttons over a oatmeal-coloured long-sleeve tunic, cinched by a wide dark-brown leather belt with a rectangular gold buckle. His straight dark-indigo trousers tuck into sturdy knee-high warm-brown leather boots with flared tops and visible stitching. A rich saffron-yellow wool cloak drapes from his left shoulder and is pinned at the right shoulder with a round gold brooch. He has small gold hoop earrings and a plain gold armlet over his right coat sleeve. In his right hand he prominently holds a large Kushan gold coin between thumb and forefinger, while at his left hip hangs a sheathed straight iron sword with a simple dark wood hilt and plain scabbard. Use a palette dominated by deep red, saffron yellow, dark indigo, warm brown and gold, and pose him front-facing with clear views of face, hair, costume, boots, cloak and his coin and sword for consistent redraws.
